tools.name: GetAddressBalances
tools.title: Get token balances for an address
tools.description:
Get token balances for an address

Returns token balances for the specified address, optionally filtered by chains.

Costs 1 API credits per call.

address.description: The blockchain address to query balances for.

chains.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns balances across all supported chains.

annotations.title: Get token balances for an address

tools.name: GetAddressCounterParty
tools.title: Get top counterparties for an address
tools.description:
Get top counterparties for an address

Returns aggregated counterparty activity by volume for the specified address.

Requires counterparties.read for all supported queries, including time ranges, incoming/outgoing direction, and filtering.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.

Costs 50 API credits per call.

address.description: The address to query counterparties for. A comma-separated list is also accepted — their counterparties are aggregated (per-counterparty volume summed across the listed addresses).

chains.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'base,bsc'). If omitted, returns counterparties across all supported chains.

flow.description: Transfer direction. Only "in" or "out" are accepted (omit for both directions).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20. Max: 1000.

tags.description: List of counterparty tags to filter by. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'whale,kol').

timeGte.description: Filter to activity after this time. Accepts RFC 3339, Unix seconds/ms, or YYYY-MM-DD.

timeLast.description: A relative window that ends now. Write it as a number and one unit, such as 1m, 15m, 24h, 7d or 1M. Units are case-sensitive. It cannot be combined with timeGte or timeLte.

timeLte.description: Filter to activity before this time. Accepts RFC 3339, Unix seconds/ms, or YYYY-MM-DD.

tokens.description: Matches counterparties involving any of these token addresses or token IDs. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,0xA0b86991…').

usdGte.description: Filter to counterparties whose aggregated USD volume is at least this value.

annotations.title: Get top counterparties for an address

tools.name: GetAddressFlow
tools.title: Get historical USD flows for an address
tools.description:
Get historical USD flows for an address

Returns historical USD inflows, outflows, and cumulative totals for the specified address across supported chains. Daily UTC buckets sum historical USD transfer values across the selected address/entity boundary, excluding internal movements. Fees and rewards are included only when represented as transfers. Solana matching includes token-account owners. Bitcoin-family operations with any selected counterparty on the opposing side are excluded, including mixed counterparties. Gaps between matching days are zero-filled; the current day may be incomplete. Cumulative totals end at the previous day. Successful results are refreshed after five minutes; during refresh failures the last successful result may be served for up to 24 hours. X-Arkham-Cached-At reports when the result was computed.

Costs 2 API credits per call.

address.description: The blockchain address to query flow data for.

chains.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

annotations.title: Get historical USD flows for an address

tools.name: GetAddressIntelligence
tools.title: Get intelligence about an address
tools.description:
Get intelligence about an address

Returns intelligence data for the specified address, including entity associations, labels, and contract status.

Costs 1 API credits per call.

chain.description: Blockchain network to query. Only one network is used: if multiple values are provided, only the first applies. If omitted, the best chain is auto-detected across all supported chains.

tools.name: GetAddressIntelligenceEnriched
tools.title: Get intelligence about an address with additional address information
tools.description:
Get intelligence about an address with additional address information

Returns the same intelligence as /intelligence/address/{address}, plus the address's tags and cluster IDs. Tags, cluster IDs and the predicted entity are each included by default; use the include parameters to leave any of them out.

Costs 2 API credits per call.

chain.description: Blockchain network to query. Only one network is used: if multiple values are provided, only the first applies. If omitted, the best chain is auto-detected across all supported chains.

includeClusters.description: Whether to include cluster IDs in the response. Defaults to 'true'.

includeEntityPredictions.description: Whether to include entity predictions in the response. A predicted entity is returned only for an address that has no known entity. Defaults to 'true'.

includeTags.description: Whether to include address tags in the response. Defaults to 'true'.

annotations.title: Get intelligence about an address with additional address information

address.description: The blockchain address to query portfolio history for.

tools.name: GetBatchAddressIntelligence
tools.title: Batch lookup address intelligence
tools.description:
Batch lookup address intelligence

Returns intelligence for up to 1000 addresses in a single request. Send a POST body with an `addresses` array of blockchain addresses. Use `chain` to look every address up on one network, or `chains` to narrow which networks are considered when each address's network is detected. Addresses that cannot be parsed are omitted from the response.

Costs 250 API credits per call.

addresses.description: Array of blockchain addresses to query (max 1000). Supports EVM, Solana, Bitcoin, Tron, and other address formats.

chain.description: Single blockchain network to filter all addresses to. Takes precedence over 'chains'. If omitted, auto-detects per address.

chains.description: Networks to consider when auto-detecting each address's network, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). Ignored when 'chain' is set.

tools.name: GetEntityBalanceChanges
tools.title: Get entity balance changes
tools.description:
Get entity balance changes

Returns a ranked list of entities with their balance changes over a specified time interval. Filter by chain, entity type, token, and balance thresholds. Useful for tracking which entities are accumulating or distributing assets.

Costs 2 API credits per call.

balanceMax.description: Maximum balance threshold in USD to filter entities.

balanceMin.description: Minimum balance threshold in USD to filter entities.

chains.description: List of chains to filter by. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bitcoin').

entityIds.description: List of specific entity IDs to filter by. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'binance,coinbase'). IDs are case-sensitive; look one up with GET /intelligence/search.

entityTags.description: List of entity tags to include. Requires elevated access; requests using this parameter without it may return 403. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'hot-wallet,kol').

entityTypes.description: List of entity types to filter by. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'cex,fund'). Valid types are listed by GET /intelligence/entity_types.

interval.description: Time interval for balance change calculation. One of '7d', '14d', or '30d'.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page. Required; must be between 1 and 100.

negatedEntityTags.description: List of entity tags to exclude. Requires elevated access; requests using this parameter without it may return 403. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'hot-wallet,kol').

offset.description: Number of results to skip from the beginning.

orderBy.description: Field to sort results by. One of: balanceUsd, balanceUsdChange, balanceUsdPctChange, balanceUnit, balanceUnitChange, balanceUnitPctChange.

orderDir.description: Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

pricingIds.description: List of CoinGecko pricing IDs to filter by. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'bitcoin,ethereum').

Get entity summary statistics

- Total balance in USD across all chains
- Total transfer volume in USD
- First and last transfer timestamps

Supports Arkham entities and user-created entities. When authenticated, user-added addresses are included for Arkham entities.

For Arkham entities, numAddresses is omitted unless the caller has the entities.address_count entitlement. User-created entity counts are always included.

**Shareable user entities:** If a user entity is marked as shareable, any authenticated or unauthenticated user can access the summary.

A master address aggregates across all of its sub-accounts; a sub-account returns only its own value.

Costs 1 API credits per call.

Get intel data usage for the current billing period

Returns your intel-data consumption for the current billing period, broken down by chain.

Usage is tracked per seat (the calling user), not account-wide: `totalLimit` is the limit for your seat and `totalCount` is the data points your seat has consumed. The response also includes the start of the current period and the per-chain breakdown of usage.

Costs 0 API credits per call.

tools.name: GetPolymarketEvent
tools.title: Get a Polymarket event
tools.description:
Get a Polymarket event

Requires predictions.read and either predictions.explorer or predictions.filter. Returns a single Polymarket event by its event ID, along with every active or resolved market in the event. Each market includes its outcomes, current Yes price, 24h volume, resolution status, resolution source, and on-chain question lifecycle. Returns 404 if the event does not exist.

Costs 1 API credits per call.

tools.name: GetPolymarketEvents
tools.title: List Polymarket events
tools.description:
List Polymarket events

Returns a filtered, paginated list of Polymarket events, each with a few top-market previews and current prices. Set groupGames=true to represent each sporting fixture by its winner event.

Costs 3 API credits per call.

active.description: Optional. Filter to active events — not closed and not ended (true/false).

excludeTag.description: Optional. Exclude events carrying this tag (case-insensitive).

groupGames.description: Optional. When true, return one winner event per sporting fixture instead of each related event. Default: false.

order.description: Sort order: asc or desc. Default: desc.

search.description: Optional. Search event titles, market questions, and grouped-market titles.

sortBy.description: Optional. Sort field: volume, endDate (resolution eligibility), or createdAt. Default: volume when no tag, endDate when tag is set.

tag.description: Optional. Filter by event tag. Matches lowercase Polymarket tags case-insensitively.

tools.name: GetPolymarketLeaderboard
tools.title: Polymarket PnL leaderboard
tools.description:
Polymarket PnL leaderboard

All queries require predictions.read; an address-specific rank or standing also requires predictions.explorer or predictions.filter. Without predictions.filter, only descending order is available; preset periods and wallet-rank lookups remain available. offset + limit may not exceed the caller's predictions.max_results, counting an omitted limit as its default of 100. Returns the Polymarket leaderboard ordered by trading PnL plus rewards for a period: 1d, 1w, 1m, or all (default 1d). periodPnl remains trading-only, and periodRewards contains the reward component. Order desc for top traders or asc for worst. Pass an address to also receive that trader's rank.

Costs 10 API credits per call.

address.description: Optional trade address. If set, also returns this user's rank.

order.description: Sort order: desc (top traders) or asc (worst traders). Default: desc

tools.name: GetPolymarketPositions
tools.title: Polymarket user positions
tools.description:
Polymarket user positions

Requires predictions.read and either predictions.explorer or predictions.filter. Without predictions.filter, positions are available in default trades-descending order. offset + limit may not exceed the caller's predictions.max_results, counting an omitted limit as its default of 50. Returns a trade address's current open positions, one row per outcome token, with net position, net USDC flow, last price, and unrealized PnL. Sort by trades (default), shares, value, or pnl. Supports offset pagination.

Costs 3 API credits per call.

addr.description: Required. Polymarket trade address (0x + 40 hex chars).

sortBy.description: Column to order by: trades (default), shares, value, pnl.

tools.name: GetPolymarketTopHolders
tools.title: Polymarket market top holders
tools.description:
Polymarket market top holders

Requires predictions.read and either predictions.explorer or predictions.filter. limit may not exceed the caller's predictions.max_results, counting an omitted limit as its default of 20. Returns the largest position holders for a market, ranked by net position, each with their per-token positions and net USDC flow. Optionally narrow to a single outcome (0 for Yes, 1 for No). Returns 404 when the conditionID has no matching tokens.

Costs 3 API credits per call.

conditionId.description: Required. Polymarket condition ID for the market.

outcome.description: Optional. 0 for Yes token, 1 for No token. Omit for all tokens.

tools.name: GetPolymarketWalletSummaryPnL
tools.title: Polymarket wallet PnL summary
tools.description:
Polymarket wallet PnL summary

Requires predictions.read and either predictions.explorer or predictions.filter. Returns a trade address's total PnL (open-position plus all-time realized), realized PnL, and counts of unique, won, and total markets traded.

Costs 2 API credits per call.

addr.description: Required. Polymarket trade address (0x + 40 hex chars).

tools.name: GetRiskScoreAddress
tools.title: Get risk score for an address
tools.description:
Get risk score for an address

Returns a compliance risk score for the specified blockchain address, including per-category exposure scores and the sources behind them. A risk_level of NONE means no exposure was identified at or above the reporting threshold. The status field indicates whether an address has been scored or yet to be processed. An address that is not valid for a supported chain returns 400.

Costs 5 API credits per call.

annotations.title: Get risk score for an address

tools.name: GetRiskScoreEntity
tools.title: Get entity-level risk score
tools.description:
Get entity-level risk score

Returns an entity's aggregated risk score, reflecting both the entity's own flagged addresses and how much of its activity connects to known risk sources. It is an entity-level measure rather than the score of any single address, so an individual address may score higher or lower than its entity. The status field indicates whether the entity has been scored or is yet to be processed. An identifier that no Arkham entity has returns 404.

Costs 5 API credits per call.

entity_id.description: The Arkham entity identifier to query, for example 'binance'. Identifiers are case-sensitive and must be sent exactly as Arkham reports them; use GET /intelligence/search to look one up.

Get supported chains list

tools.name: GetSwaps
tools.title: Get swaps
tools.description:
Get swaps

Retrieves a list of swaps (DEX trades) based on various query filters. Requires swaps.read. A single address/entity or token preview additionally requires swaps.explorer or swaps.filter. Previews are in descending time order, with optional chains and an optional usdGte=1. Additional filtering and sorting require swaps.filter. offset + limit may not exceed the caller's swaps.max_results, counting an omitted limit as its default of 20.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.

**Filter forms**: For the filter forms these parameters accept, see the [Param Filters](/usage/filters) guide.

Costs 2 API credits per row.

base.description: Filter by specific entity or address involved in the swap. Omitting it returns an empty list. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'binance,coinbase').

chains.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,solana'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

counterparties.description: List of addresses or entities to treat strictly as counterparties. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'coinbase,kraken').

flow.description: Swap direction relative to the base address. Valid values: 'in' (receiving token1), 'out' (sending token0), or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

from.description: Filter to swaps where the base sold one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'to' for a specific sold/bought trade. To match a token on either side regardless of direction use 'tokens'; to filter by the transaction parties instead, use senders/receivers. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,usd-coin').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20. Max: 1650.

offset.description: Pagination offset. offset + limit must not exceed 10000 or the caller's swaps.max_results.

protocols.description: Filter by protocol/DEX addresses or entity IDs. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'uniswap,sushiswap').

receivers.description: Filter by the transaction parties that received the swap output (receiver addresses or entities). Distinct from 'to', which filters on the bought token. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'binance,coinbase').

senders.description: Filter by the transaction parties that initiated the swap (sender addresses or entities). Distinct from 'from', which filters on the sold token. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'binance,coinbase').

sortKey.description: Field by which to sort the results. One of: time, usd.

timeGte.description: Filter swaps at or after this time (unix ms, unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD).

timeLast.description: A relative window that ends now. Write it as a number and one unit, such as 1m, 15m, 24h, 7d or 1M. Units are case-sensitive. It cannot be combined with timeGte or timeLte.

timeLte.description: Filter swaps at or before this time (unix ms, unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: Filter to swaps where the base bought one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'from' for a specific sold/bought trade. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,usd-coin').

tokens.description: List of token addresses or token IDs that appear as either token0 or token1. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,0xA0b86991…').

value0Gte.description: Minimum token0 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

value0Lte.description: Maximum token0 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

value1Gte.description: Minimum token1 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

value1Lte.description: Maximum token1 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

tools.name: GetTokenVolumeByID
tools.title: Get volume for a token by pricing ID
tools.description:
Get volume for a token by pricing ID

Returns exchange flow for the specified token, bucketed by time.

Every time range uses the same service-wallet definition. Deposits move from non-service wallets into service wallets; withdrawals move from service wallets to non-service wallets. Service-to-service movements are excluded, and there is no top-exchange limit. inUSD and inValue report deposits, while outUSD and outValue report withdrawals, in historical USD and token units respectively. Daily ranges include the current, incomplete UTC day.

For Bitcoin-family assets, flows use inflow/outflow operations. An operation is excluded if any counterparty is marked as a service.

This form resolves the token by pricing ID, so it also covers native assets such as Bitcoin and Dogecoin.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.

Costs 3 API credits per call.

id.description: The CoinGecko pricing ID of the token.

granularity.description: Bucket size for the histogram. Use a whole number of hours, from 1h up to 7d (e.g. 1h, 2h, 6h, 12h, 1d, 2d, 3d, 7d); sub-hour values and durations over 7d are rejected. Only applied when timeLast is under 30 days; for longer or omitted ranges, results are always returned in daily buckets.

timeLast.description: A relative window that ends now. Write it as a number and one unit, such as 1m, 15m, 24h, 7d or 1M. Units are case-sensitive. Windows under 30 days follow granularity. Windows of 30 days or longer return daily buckets. If omitted, the response covers all time in daily buckets.

annotations.title: Get volume for a token by pricing ID

limit.description: Maximum number of addresses to return per flow direction. Default: 50. Max: 100.

timeLast.description: A relative window that ends now. Write it as a number and one unit, such as 1m, 15m, 24h, 7d or 1M. Units are case-sensitive.

tools.name: GetTopTokenHoldersByChainAddress
tools.title: Get top token holders by chain and address
tools.description:
Get top token holders by chain and address

Returns the top token holders for a specific token contract on a given chain. Results are sorted by balance in descending order.

Only chains with token contracts (EVM chains, Solana, Tron) are supported here. For UTXO assets like Bitcoin, use the pricing-ID form (/token/holders/{id}).

**Response fields:**
- **token**: Token metadata (name, symbol, pricing info).
- **totalSupply**: Total supply for the chain.
- **addressTopHolders**: Top holders by individual address.
- **entityTopHolders**: Top holders grouped by entity (only present when groupByEntity=true).

**Note:** Entity objects in the response do not include `populatedTags`. Use `GET /intelligence/entity/{id}` to retrieve tags for individual entities.

Costs 30 API credits per call.

groupByEntity.description: If 'true', groups holdings by entity rather than individual addresses.

limit.description: Maximum number of holders to return per page (default 100, max 100). offset + limit must not exceed 1000.

offset.description: Number of holders to skip for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: GetTransaction
tools.title: Get transaction details
tools.description:
Get transaction details

Retrieves detailed information about a specific blockchain transaction using its hash.

The endpoint searches across all supported chains to find the transaction. If it is not found in confirmed transactions, it also checks the mempool for pending transactions.

**Hash format.** Write the hash as its chain does: `0x`-prefixed hex on EVM chains and HyperCore, bare hex on Tron and the UTXO chains, and a base58 signature on Solana. A hash written in another chain's format is not looked up on the chains that write it differently.

**Response shape.** The response body is a JSON object keyed by chain identifier (for example "ethereum"). Because the same hash format can appear on more than one chain, the object may contain more than one entry, one per chain on which the transaction was found. Each value holds that chain's transaction details. The exact set of fields varies by chain, but consumers can generally expect:

- the block number and block timestamp the transaction was included in,
- the sender and recipient addresses,
- gas used and gas-related fields, along with the transaction fee,
- the value transferred in native units and its USD value at the time,
- token details for any tokens involved in the transfer,
- for a HyperEVM transaction, `hypercoreActions`: the HyperCore actions on record that it drove through CoreWriter, in execution order, each with the HyperCore block and time it executed in, the account it acted for, and the raw action; omitted when none is on record.
- `bridges`: the cross-chain bridges the transaction is one leg of, each with its protocol, status, and a `source` and `destination` leg naming the chain, address, token and amount at either end. A bridge is listed on both the transaction that paid into it and the transaction it paid out, so either hash finds it, and `id` is the same on both. One transaction can carry several bridges, such as a batch settlement; at most 100 are listed. Omitted when the transaction is part of no bridge. Protocols covered: Relay, Across, deBridge, Unit, Circle CCTP and Gateway, LayerZero, Stargate, THORChain and Maya.

**Not found.** If the hash is not found on any supported chain (neither confirmed nor pending), the endpoint returns 404.

Costs 2 API credits per call.

hash.description: The transaction hash to look up.

tools.name: GetTransfers
tools.title: Get transfers
tools.description:
Get transfers

Retrieves a list of transfers based on various query filters.

**Transfer access:** Requires transfers.read. Without transfers.filter, the default feed is descending by time, with no filters except chains and an optional usdGte=1. transfers.explorer additionally permits one address or entity as base, or base=all with one token. Combining a specific base and token, or changing other filters or sorting, requires transfers.filter. Full filtering includes explorer queries. Separately, offset + limit may not exceed the caller's transfers.max_results, counting an omitted limit as its default of 20. Logged-out access comes from the anonymous plan over the default plan; its initial grants permit only the default feed's first 50 results. A missing capability or a request past transfers.max_results returns 401 for logged-out callers or 403 for authenticated callers.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.

**Sequence ranges:** Every chain numbers its transfers as they are indexed, and `includeCursors=true` reports each chain's latest number. Pass **seqGte** and **seqLte** to fetch one chain's transfers between two of those numbers — for example, to poll incrementally without missing or repeating a transfer by walking from the last sequence you saw to the latest one reported. A sequence range needs exactly one chain, one whose transfers carry sequences, and may span at most 10,000,000 sequences; a range spanning more is walked in segments, the last of them ending at the chain's reported number. A range must end at or below that number — a **seqLte** beyond it is rejected, because the transfers up to it are not all searchable yet, and a chain reporting no number yet accepts no range at all. Sequences begin when a chain's numbering was introduced, so older transfers carry no **seq** and ranges below the earliest sequenced transfer return nothing. It cannot be combined with **timeLast**, which moves with the clock — use **timeGte** and **timeLte**. A sequence range comes back in ascending sequence order and so cannot be combined with **sortKey** or **sortDir**, and every transfer in it carries its own **seq**. That is how you page a range: a response with fewer than **limit** transfers has completed it, and a full one is continued by repeating the request with **seqGte** set to the last transfer's **seq** plus one. **count** is capped and does not report whether any of the range remains.

**Real-time streaming:** For live transfer notifications instead of polling, use the WebSocket API. See GET /ws/transfers for real-time streaming with transfer filtering. Service-wallet selectors are supported on the HTTP transfer endpoints only.

**Filter forms**: For the filter forms these parameters accept, see the [Param Filters](/usage/filters) guide.

Costs 2 API credits per row.

base.description: Filter from or to any of these entities or addresses. Prefix a value with '!' to exclude it, or 'type:' to filter by entity type, so 'type:cex,!binance' returns all exchanges except binance. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'binance,coinbase').

chains.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns transfers across all supported chains.

counterparties.description: list of addresses or entities to treat strictly as counterparties (only base <-> counterparty transfers). Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'coinbase,kraken').

from.description: Filter from any of these addresses, entities, deposit services, or service wallets. Prefix a value with '!' to exclude it, 'type:' to filter on entity types (such as 'type:cex'), 'deposit:' to filter on deposit addresses (such as 'deposit:binance'), or 'service:' for service wallets (such as 'service:binance' or 'service:all'). Service-wallet filters support EVM, Tron, and Solana; omit chains to search those chains, or specify only supported chains. Positive values are alternatives (OR). Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. '0xd8dA6BF2…,deposit:binance').

includeCursors.description: Include per-chain as-of cursors in the response. Default: false.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20. Max: 1650.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Default: 0. offset + limit must not exceed 10000 or the caller's transfers.max_results.

seqGte.description: Return transfers at or after this chain sequence, as reported in cursors and on each returned transfer. Requires seqLte and exactly one chain, and only chains whose transfers carry sequences are supported. Sequences begin when a chain's numbering was introduced; parts of a range below the earliest sequenced transfer return nothing.

seqLte.description: Return transfers at or before this chain sequence. Requires seqGte, and the range may span at most 10,000,000 sequences. Must be at or below the chain's latest sequence as reported by includeCursors; a higher value is rejected, as is any range on a chain that reports no sequence yet. A sequence range cannot be combined with timeLast; use timeGte and timeLte.

sortDir.description: Direction for sorting results. Default: desc.

sortKey.description: Field by which to sort the results. Default: time. Custom sorting requires transfers.filter; previews are sorted by time, descending.

timeGte.description: Filter after a specific time (RFC3339, YYYY-MM-DD, or Unix timestamp).

timeLast.description: A relative window that ends now. Write it as a number and one unit, such as 1m, 15m, 24h, 7d or 1M. Units are case-sensitive. It cannot be combined with timeGte or timeLte.

timeLte.description: Filter before a specific time (RFC3339, YYYY-MM-DD, or Unix timestamp).

to.description: Filter to any of these addresses, entities, deposit services, or service wallets. Prefix a value with '!' to exclude it, 'type:' to filter on entity types (such as 'type:cex'), 'deposit:' to filter on deposit addresses (such as 'deposit:binance'), or 'service:' for service wallets (such as 'service:binance' or 'service:all'). Service-wallet filters support EVM, Tron, and Solana; omit chains to search those chains, or specify only supported chains. Positive values are alternatives (OR). Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. '0xd8dA6BF2…,deposit:binance').

tokens.description: Filter involving any of these token addresses or token IDs. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,0xA0b86991…').

usdGte.description: Filter above a minimum historical USD value.

usdLte.description: Filter below a maximum historical USD value.

valueGte.description: Filter above a minimum token amount (the quantity of tokens, not the USD value).

valueLte.description: Filter below a maximum token amount (the quantity of tokens, not the USD value).

tools.name: GetTransfersHistogram
tools.title: Get a detailed histogram of transfers (API Only)
tools.description:
Get a detailed histogram of transfers (API Only)

Returns an aggregated histogram of transfers over time, bucketed by `granularity`. Each bucket carries the transfer count and the total historical USD value, and its `time` is the start of the bucket.

**Bucket alignment.** Buckets start on the granularity boundary: 30-minute buckets at 12:00, 12:30, and so on. `bucketOffset` moves every boundary by a duration, so `granularity=30m&bucketOffset=-60s` gives buckets starting at 11:59, 12:29, 12:59, each reported at its shifted start. This lets a caller that acts on the half hour read a bucket that closed a minute before it, once every transfer in it has been indexed. A shifted histogram is accepted only with a granularity of 1h or finer over a range of at most 30 days, so it stays fast for any base. The time filter is applied to transfers, not buckets: a `timeGte` or `timeLte` inside a bucket returns that bucket with only the transfers in range, and `timeLte` is inclusive, so end a range one second before the next bucket starts to keep it out.

**Requires an API key** (browser-session and anonymous access are not permitted).

**A `base` filter is required.** Without one, the response is an empty list. With `base=all`, add at least one more filter (time range, `from`/`to`, token, or USD or value bound); `type:` (except `type:shielded`) and `!` values do not count.

**Filtering** uses the same filter parameters as GET /transfers. The response is the complete aggregation over the filtered range — there is no pagination or sorting. Periods with no matching transfers are omitted, so buckets are not necessarily contiguous.

A fine `granularity` over a long range can cover more periods than can be aggregated, which is answered with a 400: use a coarser granularity, or narrow the range with `timeGte` and `timeLte`.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.

**Filter forms**: For the filter forms these parameters accept, see the [Param Filters](/usage/filters) guide.

Costs 4 API credits per call.

base.description: Filter from or to any of these entities or addresses. Prefix a value with '!' to exclude it, or 'type:' to filter by entity type, so 'type:cex,!binance' returns all exchanges except binance. Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'binance,coinbase').

bucketOffset.description: Shift every bucket boundary by this duration, for example '-60s' or '-1m'. Buckets normally start on the granularity boundary (12:00, 12:30, ...); with a 30m granularity and a -60s offset they start at 11:59, 12:29, ... and each bucket's time reports where it starts. Default: no shift.

chains.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns transfers across all supported chains.

counterparties.description: list of addresses or entities to treat strictly as counterparties (only base <-> counterparty transfers). Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'coinbase,kraken').

from.description: Filter from any of these addresses, entities, deposit services, or service wallets. Prefix a value with '!' to exclude it, 'type:' to filter on entity types (such as 'type:cex'), 'deposit:' to filter on deposit addresses (such as 'deposit:binance'), or 'service:' for service wallets (such as 'service:binance' or 'service:all'). Service-wallet filters support EVM, Tron, and Solana; omit chains to search those chains, or specify only supported chains. Positive values are alternatives (OR). Pass several as a single comma-separated value (e.g. '0xd8dA6BF2…,deposit:binance').

granularity.description: Histogram bucket size. Calendar units: '1m' (minute), '1h' (hour), '1d' (day), '1w' (week), '1M' (month), '1q' (quarter), '1y' (year). Fixed widths: '5m', '15m', '30m', '2h', '4h', '6h', '12h'. Note that '1m' is a minute and '1M' is a month.
